scope: Existing Premium installation, one existing provider account, unchanged Connect/Nova authorization contract. This follow-up corrects provider evidence and recovery controls after the bounded real Connect acceptance; it does not repeat OAuth or add a product surface.

semantics.availability: Unknown is the default; credential freshness and relay confirmation do not establish continuous provider health.
semantics.positive: Confirmed provider completion settles success=true under the existing fenced central health rules.
semantics.negative: An attributable provider availability/access failure settles success=false. Request/model validation alone does not establish account failure.
semantics.neutral: Cancellation, deadlines, lost transport, local admission/authorization failure and restart recovery settle success=null without modifying success/failure history.
semantics.terminal: Unknown remains terminal. Settlement retry is permitted; execution replay is not.
semantics.recovery_controls: Failure history is advisory; reconnect remains under its existing registration authority. Enable separately requires current credentials, fresh relay/control state, execution policy and no current access block or future cooldown.

execution_migration.preflight: Matching installation, exact prior function, only original execution migration, 30 retained records and zero active/unsettled records.
execution_migration.apply: Execution-only transaction with identity/history/drain guards, short lock/statement limits and migration-history insertion. No primary database migration or historical backfill.
execution_migration.privileges: Pinned search_path and existing definer/role boundary preserved. Runtime direct table reads and anonymous execution remain denied.
execution_migration.advisors: Execution project security advisors reported no issues before and after.
execution_migration.rollback: DOWN restores the original function while retaining rows. Coordinate with a runtime execution hold; old runtime code coerces neutral outcomes into failures. Prefer forward repair.
